title: Sling Four
tagline: Pull the string and sling your coins.
description: A fast slingshot coin game for 2 to 4 players on one screen. Drag a coin to your string, pull it back and let go to fire it into another quarter. Clear your own quarter first to win.
bestFor: quick matches with friends on one screen, or solo against bots.
controls: 2 to 4 players on one screen, with any seat set to a bot (Easy, Normal or Hard). Drag a coin to your string, pull back, and release.
glance: drag a coin to your string, pull back, and let go.
short: A fast slingshot coin game for 2 to 4 players on one screen. Fire your coins into other quarters and clear your own first.
about: A fast slingshot coin game for 2 to 4 players on one screen. Each player owns a corner and four coins. Drag a coin to your string, pull it back and let go to sling it into another quarter, and clear your own quarter first to win. Any seat can be played by a bot at Easy, Normal or Hard level.
saves: how many rounds each colour has won

guide.goal: Each player owns one quarter of the board and starts with 4 coins. Fire your coins into the other quarters, and be the first to empty your own.
controls: Touch a coin in your quarter
Drag the coin to the string across your corner
Pull back further for a harder shot; pull to one side to aim
tips: Everyone plays at the same time, so there are no turns. Speed matters.
Drag a coin to a free spot in your own quarter first if you want to reposition it before firing.
A harder pull sends the coin further, so a gentle pull keeps a shot short.
On the start screen, tap a corner to switch a seat between Human and Bot. Easy bots are slow and wild, Hard bots aim for the player with the fewest coins.
The board is square and fits any screen, so you can play on a phone laid flat between two to four people.
faq: Two to four players on one screen, and any seat can be a bot.
